verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies a chart of accounts and offers one vague hint at tags. Wave says it uses 'real, double-entry accounting', and its homepage line 'Tag it, track it, and see what's working for your business' loosely suggests a tagging dimension, but nothing documents customizing the chart of accounts. Missing for 10: documented chart-of-accounts customization, configurable account types, sub-account hierarchy, class/tag dimensions tied to ledger accounts, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
